summary: Russia launched a large-scale drone and missile barrage across central and southern Ukraine targeting Kyiv, Kryvyi Rih, Zhytomyr, Poltava, and Odesa. Ukraine struck back with drones hitting the Novokuybyshevsk refinery in Samara and the Tsymbulovo drone launch base in Oryol region. Ukrainian forces regained ground near Zapadnoye while Russian forces pressured Mykolaivka near Sloviansk.
key_points: Russian jet-powered UAVs and cruise missiles attacked Kyiv, Kryvyi Rih, Zhytomyr, Poltava, and Odesa regions simultaneously. (Source: @kpszsu/79545)
Four cruise missiles struck Kryvyi Rih; at least five missiles destroyed a Naftogaz facility in Poltava region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75503)
Russian strike hit the German-owned Kromberg & Schubert plant in Zhytomyr causing massive fire. (Source: @eRadarrua/115640)
Ukrainian drones attacked Novokuybyshevsk refinery in Samara and Tsymbulovo drone base in Oryol region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84227)
Ukrainian strike in Kherson region killed 15 FSB officers and wounded ~30 per Crimean Wind monitoring. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)
DeepState map confirms Ukrainian forces regained control near Zapadnoye. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23849)
Russian MoD claims strikes on Odesa logistics centers Palma and Novaya Liniya and a dry cargo ship. (Source: @tass_agency/396796)
Ukrainian 'Vivaldi' operation halted Russian encirclement of Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration near Lyman. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted a massive coordinated drone and missile attack across Ukraine targeting energy, industrial, and military infrastructure in at least six oblasts. Ukraine responded with strategic strikes on Russian oil refining and drone production capacity in Samara and Oryol regions. On the eastern front, Ukrainian forces stabilized the Lyman sector but face renewed Russian pressure on Mykolaivka.

points: Ukrainian drones struck the Novokuybyshevsk oil refinery in Samara region, continuing the campaign against Russian energy infrastructure. (Source: @UkraineNow/84227)

OSINT-confirmed strikes hit the Tsymbulovo drone launch base in Oryol region, destroying two drone bunkers, two warehouses, and a Geran-5 launch pad with multiple detonations. (Source: @UkraineNow/84234)
Ukrainian forces eliminated 15 FSB personnel and wounded approximately 30 in a strike on Strilkove in Kherson region, per Crimean Wind satellite imagery analysis. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)
Drone operators from the 'Dnipro' troop group are actively engaging and destroying Russian UAVs over Ukrainian airspace. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33437)
DeepState mapping shows Ukrainian Defense Forces have regained control of positions near Zapadnoye, indicating localized counter-offensive success. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23849)

Russian forces launched waves of jet-powered Shahed-type UAVs across Vinnytsia, Kirovohrad, Cherkasy, Chernihiv, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Odesa, and Mykolaiv regions throughout the day. (Source: @kpszsu/79545)
Four 'Banderyol' cruise missiles targeted Kryvyi Rih from the south, with additional missile strikes reported on Dnipro, Krivoy Rog, and Pavlograd industrial facilities. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75503)
At least five missiles destroyed a Naftogaz facility in Poltava region, causing critical damage beyond repair according to the company press service. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33433)
Russian strike hit the 100% German-owned Kromberg & Schubert automotive cable plant in Zhytomyr, triggering a massive fire at the foreign-invested enterprise. (Source: @eRadarrua/115640)
Interpipe Steel pipe-rolling plant halted production following a Russian Armed Forces strike on the facility. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33432)
Russian Ministry of Defense claims precision strikes on Odesa logistics centers 'Palma' and 'Novaya Liniya' and a dry cargo ship delivering military cargo in the port. (Source: @tass_agency/396796)

Ukrainian 'Vivaldi' operation on the Lyman axis successfully halted Russian attempts to encircle the Sloviansk-Kramatorsk agglomeration, per DeepState co-founder Roman Pohorilyi. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)
Russian forces have redirected combat power southward toward Mykolaivka, a key nodal point before Sloviansk, where the situation is described as difficult but controlled. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)
Ukrainian forces regained control of positions near Zapadnoye according to the latest DeepState map update. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23849)
Jet-powered UAVs detected over Chernihiv region near Koriukivka and Ripky on southwesterly courses toward Kyiv. (Source: @kpszsu/79571)
Multiple Shahed-type drones entered Kyiv airspace from the north via Hostomel and Irpin directions, targeting central Kyiv districts. (Source: @kpszsu/79558)
Kyiv air defense engaged at least two Shahed drones over the capital and Irpin, with air raid alerts active from 17:20 until 18:30 local time. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75502)
Strike UAV bypassed Kaharlyk toward Bila Tserkva in Kyiv region, while jet UAVs tracked toward Zhytomyr from the north. (Source: @kpszsu/79541)
Russian jet-powered UAV detected over Mykolaiv region heading toward Olshanske. (Source: @kpszsu/79536)
UAV over Shyriaieve in Odesa region on northerly course toward Vinnytsia. (Source: @kpszsu/79563)
Russian MoD claims destruction of Odesa logistics infrastructure and a military cargo vessel in the port. (Source: @tass_agency/396796)
Ukrainian strike in Kherson region (Strilkove) inflicted significant FSB casualties per satellite monitoring. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)

Massive Russian drone wave: 5 'Banderyol' cruise missiles from south past Khrystoforivka toward Kirovohrad; groups of jet UAVs on Kryvyi Rih; multiple Shaheds over Kyiv, Cherkasy, Zhytomyr regions. (Source: @eRadarrua/115598)
Kyiv air raid alert declared at 17:20 (drone threat, yellow level) and lifted at 18:30 on 22.09.2026. (Source: @eRadarrua/115636)
Shahed drones targeted TETs-5 power plant and warehouse facilities in Kyiv, with confirmed impacts reported. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/75472)
Ukrainian drone operators from 'Dnipro' grouping actively intercepting Russian UAVs over Ukrainian territory. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33437)
Russian drone launch infrastructure degraded: Tsymbulovo drone port in Oryol hit with multiple detonations destroying Geran-5 assets. (Source: @UkraineNow/84234)

key_developments: Russia launched coordinated drone/missile barrage across 8+ Ukrainian oblasts including Kyiv, Kryvyi Rih, Zhytomyr, Poltava, Odesa using Shahed UAVs and Banderyol cruise missiles. (Source: @kpszsu/79545)
Ukrainian strikes destroyed Russian drone launch base Tsymbulovo in Oryol region (2 bunkers, 2 warehouses, Geran-5 pad) and hit Novokuybyshevsk refinery in Samara. (Source: @UkraineNow/84234)
Russian missiles destroyed Naftogaz facility in Poltava (5+ missiles) and hit German-owned Kromberg & Schubert plant in Zhytomyr causing major fire. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33433)
Ukrainian strike in Kherson killed 15 FSB officers, wounded ~30 at Strilkove per Crimean Wind satellite imagery. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)
Ukrainian 'Vivaldi' operation stopped Russian encirclement of Sloviansk-Kramatorsk; Russians now pressuring Mykolaivka. (Source: @UkraineNow/84238)
DeepState confirms Ukrainian forces regained ground near Zapadnoye on eastern front. (Source: @DeepStateUA/23849)

sections.threat_assessment: Russia maintains capacity for large-scale, multi-axis drone and missile strikes targeting Ukrainian energy, defense industry, and logistics across the strategic depth. The simultaneous use of jet-powered Shaheds and Banderyol cruise missiles indicates sophisticated saturation tactics. Ukraine's demonstrated ability to strike Russian strategic infrastructure (refineries, drone bases) and high-value personnel (FSB in Kherson) suggests improving long-range precision capabilities. The eastern front remains dynamic with Russian forces adapting after Lyman setback by shifting pressure to Mykolaivka.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian air defense engaged multiple incoming waves over Kyiv and central regions with alerts lasting over an hour. Civilian infrastructure in Zhytomyr (foreign-owned plant) and Poltava (Naftogaz) suffered severe damage, escalating economic warfare dimensions. Russian claims of Odesa port strikes signal continued targeting of grain/weapons logistics. No immediate NATO or partner response statements appear in the source data.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Tsymbulovo drone base strike represents significant degradation of Russian Geran-5 launch capacity in Oryol. Ukrainian 'Dnipro' grouping drone-on-drone interceptions suggest maturing counter-UAV tactics. The Banderyol cruise missile designation appears in multiple sources indicating a specific weapon system in Russian inventory. FSB casualties in Kherson imply Ukrainian targeting of Russian security apparatus behind front lines. Interpipe Steel shutdown shows direct impact on Ukrainian defense industrial base.
